hooks.command: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm run lint:fix --if-present; elif [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then ruff check --fix --quiet . 2>/dev/null || true; fi

if [ "$(jq -r ".stop_hook_active // false")" = true ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ -f package.json ]; then npm run typecheck --if-present >&2 || exit 2; elif [ -f Cargo.toml ]; then cargo check --quiet >&2 || exit 2; elif [ -f go.mod ]; then go vet ./... >&2 || exit 2; fi
